content.content:
72:Nothing changes, and the reason appears at the foot of the inspector. Frame Job works down this list and stops at the first one it meets. It takes the nest, caption page and detached pair rows together, clip by clip, and the last two rows the same way:
4 pages, 0 problems
docs site: 0 problems

fixed.was: Trims, slips, rolls, splits, freeze frames and transitions all read the ramp, so each cut or held frame is the frame the ramp actually plays.
fixed.now: Transitions dropped from the list.
fixed.evidence: core/src/edit_transition.rs:110 moves a later clip's source at its base rate (later.speed), not through the ramp, and a transition makes no cut or held frame.

fixed.was: Frame Job only stops a change that takes it further past the end.
fixed.now: Being past the end stops only a change that takes it further past.
fixed.evidence: core/src/edit_action.rs:169-250: set_action still refuses an overlap with another action and a read past the file, so 'only' was too wide.

fixed.was: Clip ▸ Speed Ramp… also won't apply a preset when: the span runs past the clip's end.
fixed.now: A preset also won't apply when an agent gives a span that runs past the clip's end (the sheet's span never does).
fixed.evidence: app/Sources/SpeedRampSheetController.swift span(of:range:) returns nil (the whole clip) unless the range lies inside the clip; the refusal is reachable only through add_speed_ramp's from/to (core/src/edit_action_ramp.rs).

fixed.was: Every refused edit beeps and shows the reason, including in the Speed Ramp sheet and for moving or resizing an action.
fixed.now: The sheet's readout shows the reason before anything is applied, with no beep. Dragging an action's band gives no beep and no reason, and the band stays at the last place that worked.
fixed.evidence: app/Sources/ProjectDocument.swift updateLiveEdit swallows every answer but .applied; app/Sources/ActionDragSession.swift header; app/Sources/SpeedRampSheetController.swift syncControls disables Apply.

fixed.was: After a steep slow-down, for example ×2 to ×0.5, it can run up to about 22 ms behind the picture.
fixed.now: After a deep slow-down, it can run up to about 24 ms behind the picture.
fixed.evidence: app/Sources/RampAudioRenderer+TimePitch.swift:24-29 says a deep slow-down lands up to about 24 ms late. This is a code comment, the only code evidence for a measured figure. The ×2 to ×0.5 example is not in the product code.

fixed.was: Undo and redo start a render too, because the file from before the edit isn't kept.
fixed.now: Undo and redo usually start a render too, because Frame Job drops the file from before the edit once a newer render lands.
fixed.evidence: app/Sources/ProjectDocument+RampAudio.swift rampAudioDidSettle is the only caller of RampAudioCache.prune, and it runs only when a render lands or fails. app/Sources/RampAudioRenders.swift reconcileLocked skips a file already on disk, so undoing an edit that started no render finds the old file and renders nothing.

fixed.was: Its progress reads **Preparing…** during the wait, and you can cancel it there.
fixed.now: The Exporting sheet reads "Preparing “*name*”…" during the wait, and a queued export's row reads `Writing · 0 %`. You can cancel either one there.
fixed.evidence: app/Sources/ExportProgressSheetController.swift:91 and the Cancel button at stopClicked; app/Sources/ExportQueueWindowController.swift:416-426 (job.phase ?? "Writing"); app/Sources/Exporter.swift:416-422 keeps progress at 0 during the wait.

fixed.was: An image sequence has no sound, so it doesn't wait.
fixed.now: An animated GIF or APNG has no sound, so it doesn't wait.
fixed.evidence: app/Sources/ExporterImageSequence.swift:58 and app/Sources/Exporter+RampAudio.swift withRampAudio's isImageSequence guard. The ImageIO path is the GIF and APNG rows, so 'image sequence' was internal wording.

fixed.was: When a speed-up or a ramp makes the clip play further into its file, the new part gets no captions.
fixed.now: When a ramp makes the clip play further into its file, the new part gets no captions.
fixed.evidence: core/src/edit_clip_timing.rs set_speed and rate_stretch keep the clip's source window. Only a ramp, which keeps the clip's slot, reads further (core/src/edit_action_speed.rs module doc).

fixed.was: Only speed and ramp edits move captions.
fixed.now: Only speed and ramp edits re-time captions.
fixed.evidence: app/Sources/CaptionRetime.swift mayRetime lists the re-timing ops. Other edits, such as a ripple, can still move a caption clip, so 'move' was too wide.

fixed.was: Frame Job checks these in order and stops at the first one it meets.
fixed.now: Frame Job works down this list and stops at the first one it meets. It takes the nest, caption page and detached pair rows together, clip by clip, and the last two rows the same way.
fixed.evidence: core/src/edit_retime.rs retime_refusal's single loop over clips in the range tests nest, then timed words, then linked for each clip; the loop over pieces runs piece_refusal, testing rate then one frame for each piece.

removed: speed/ramp-audio, Keep pitch off: "exact to the sample". The code can't settle it. app/Sources/RampAudioRenderer.swift position() and the resampler give a mapped position and an interpolated sample, and nothing defines or pins sample exactness.
speed/ramp-audio, Keep pitch on: the example "for example ×2 to ×0.5". It isn't in the product code.
guide_errors: docs/guide/speed.md:240: 'Trims, slips, rolls, splits, freeze frames and transitions also follow the ramp'. A transition moves the later clip's source at its base rate (core/src/edit_transition.rs:110). docs/site/src/data/features.json:6727 repeats this summary and needs the same fix; it wasn't in this task's pages.
docs/guide/speed.md:273: 'When a speed-up or a ramp makes the clip play further into its file'. A constant speed-up keeps the clip's source window, so only a ramp does this.
docs/guide/speed.md:293: 'the span runs past the clip's end' is listed for the Speed Ramp sheet, but the sheet's span can't run past the clip's end. Only add_speed_ramp's from/to can.

docs/guide/speed.md:310: 'Undo and redo render again too, because the file from before…' isn't always true. The file is pruned only when a render lands or fails, so undoing an edit that started no render, such as removing a ramp, finds the old file still on disk.
docs/guide/speed.md:317: 'sample-exact' is not something the code settles.
docs/guide/speed.md:320 and :509: 'about 22 ms' disagrees with app/Sources/RampAudioRenderer+TimePitch.swift:28, which says up to about 24 ms (22 ms is one measured case).
docs/guide/speed.md:324 and docs/guide/export.md:306-308: 'Preparing…' is not the text shown. The sheet reads 'Preparing “name”…' and a queued export's row reads 'Writing · 0 %'.
